newsitem.title: UK: IBCA says may downgrade Guadeloupe A plus l-term.
newsitem.headline: IBCA says may downgrade Guadeloupe A plus l-term.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Thursday it had placed the A plus long-term rating of the department of Guadeloupe on RatingWatch with negative implications.
The rating is a subnational rating of France, IBCA said in a statement.

"Today's decision has been taken in the wake of the discovery by the Prefect of the Region of Guadeloupe --the representative of the French state-- of an omission from the Department's budget of a provision for a payment due to the Caisse Regionale de Securite Sociale (General Social Security Fund)," IBCA said.
"This means that there is a technical imbalance in the Departments's budget, which in effect is against French law."
IBCA said it would make its final decision on the rating of Guadeloupe once it has examined this issue more closely and determined its impact on the financial situation of the Department.
